text: A woman's photo on a loan letter. Men borrowed like the rate had dropped.
Think ads don't work on you?
A South African lender mailed loan offers to over fifty-three thousand past customers.
Each letter got a random interest rate, from about three to twelve percent a month.
And random little extras. Like a smiling photo in the corner.
For men, swapping a man's photo for a woman's pulled in as many borrowers as cutting the rate four and a half points a month.
Same loan. Same terms. Just a face.
So next time, cover the photo. Read the rate.
